title: AERON_flight_model node extension
description: The role of a node in an Aeron flight model, and its data. The default scene has one model-role root; its ordered direct children are 1 to 255 component-role mesh nodes; a component's ordered children are hardpoint, engine-glow and light empty nodes, plus at most one collision mesh node. Child order gives the component, hardpoint and engine-glow ordinals. Unknown fields are ignored.

vec3.title: Vector
vec3.description: A glTF-space vector, in metres for positions.

extent3.title: Extent
extent3.description: A size along each glTF axis, in metres, kept signed as authored.

color.title: Colour
color.description: RGBA as 8-bit sRGB values over 255, alpha included.

tag.title: Name
tag.description: A game-defined name: 1 to 63 characters among lower-case ASCII letters, digits, '.' and '_'.

ordinal.title: Component ordinal
ordinal.description: A component's position among the model root's children. It indexes the game's per-component state, so it may be past this model's components when the game draws another model, such as a cockpit, with the same state.

energy.title: Energy effects
energy.description: The energy effects shown: any of shields (shield hits and shields going down), tractor and jamming (beams). An empty array shows none.

articulation.title: Articulation
articulation.description: A component the game turns about its rotation hinge. Aeron stores articulations without interpreting them; each game documents the groups and behaviors it reads.

group.description: The game-defined group it belongs to, such as the S-foils.

angle.title: Angle
angle.description: The angle it turns to, in the game's units of 1/256 turn.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: How fast it turns there, in 1/256 turn per game step.

speedBack.title: Speed back
speedBack.description: How fast it turns back, in 1/256 turn per game step; default speed.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model root, the scene's one root node.

componentSets.title: Component sets
componentSets.description: Named sets of components, keyed by game-defined names; repeats are ignored. Aeron stores them without interpreting them; each game documents the sets it reads (such as the components a profile hides).

articulationSettings.title: Articulation settings
articulationSettings.description: Game-defined integer settings of the articulations, keyed by name.

skinVariants.title: Skin variants
skinVariants.description: Material variants built from the materials' skins. The cooker composites each into the KHR_materials_variants variant of the same name, or into a new variant after them.

markings.title: Markings
markings.description: The look of each markings value the game gives an object (0 to 255): entry m names the variant (KHR_materials_variants or skinVariants) markings value m shows, or null for the primitives' own materials. A value past the end shows the last entry; without the array, every value shows the own materials.

energy.description: The energy effects of every material without its own. Without it, such materials show none.

reflectionProbes.title: Reflection probes
reflectionProbes.description: The probes that an authoring tool bakes for the model. Source files only: cooked files contain probeData instead.

position.description: In the model's frame, in metres.

size.description: The influence's full extent (an ellipsoid's axes), in metres.

falloff.description: The outer fraction of the influence over which its weight falls to 0.

parallaxSize.description: The volume reflections are projected on; default the influence.

roomParallax.description: Projected on the light grid's box instead, which several probes of a room share.

filled.description: Set on probes that the authoring tool's fill made. The next fill replaces them.

lightGrid.title: Light grid
lightGrid.description: The irradiance grid that an authoring tool uses to bake the model's probes. Source files only.

position.description: In the model's frame, in metres.

size.description: The zone the grid lights fully, its full extent in metres.

spacing.description: About how far apart its points are, in metres.

keyLightShadow.description: When the scene's key light, such as a hangar's ceiling light, is in the bake, its shadow removes this share of the probes' light.

reflectionPlane.title: Reflection plane
reflectionPlane.description: A floor facing +y, such as a hangar floor, that reflects the objects standing on it. Cooked files keep it, and the game reads it. The game uses it only with the model's probes.

position.description: In the model's frame, in metres.

size.description: Its full extent along x and z, in metres.

distance.description: How far from it the model's surfaces show the reflection, in metres.

skinVariant.title: Skin variant
skinVariant.description: A material variant made of skin layers. On a primitive whose material has at least one of its skins, it shows the material with those layers composited in order; on any other primitive, the material of the KHR_materials_variants variant of the same name, else the base variant's, else the own one.

name.title: Name
name.description: Unique among skinVariants. The name of a KHR_materials_variants variant adds the layers to that variant.

base.title: Base variant
base.description: Another KHR_materials_variants variant the skin variant starts from. Without it, the primitives' own materials.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Skins applied in order. Required, and not empty, unless the skin variant has a base or the name of a KHR_materials_variants variant.

skin.title: Skin
skin.description: A skin name of the materials.

rotation.title: Rotation frame
rotation.description: The component's hinge and frame: what an articulation turns it about, and how the game aims a turret. The vectors are kept as authored, not normalized or orthogonalized.

pivot.description: The point it turns about, in the component's space.

rotationAxis.description: The axis it turns about. An axis of length s turns it by about s times the angle.

component.title: Component
component.description: A mesh node the game simulates as one part of the model: it can be hit, damaged, destroyed, turned or hidden.

meshType.title: Mesh type
meshType.description: The game's type of the part (OPT mesh type: main hull, wing, engine, gun turret...).

explosionFlags.title: Explosion flags
explosionFlags.description: The game's flags of the part (OPT explosion type), as a bitmask: 1 gives it its own hit points, 2 makes it damageable.

targetId.title: Target group
targetId.description: Components with the same nonzero id and mesh type form one target; 0 for none.

target.description: The point the game aims at on this target, required with a nonzero targetId.

span.description: Descriptor: the part's authored size. Stock OPT descriptors include negative components, which the games read as stored.

boundsMin.description: Descriptor: the part's authored minimum corner.

boundsMax.description: Descriptor: the part's authored maximum corner.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Game-defined names binding the component to a role the game identifies by name instead of ordinal, such as hangarcrane.arm. Duplicates are ignored.

allOf.description: The descriptor's four fields go together. Without them, the loader computes them from the simulation topology.

hardpoint.title: Hardpoint
hardpoint.description: An empty node where the game fires or launches from; translation only.

type.title: Type
type.description: The game's hardpoint type (OPT weapon type: laser, ion cannon, torpedo...).

collision.title: Collision mesh
collision.description: A mesh node, direct child of a component, whose mesh is the component's simulation topology instead of its render mesh. Never rendered; at most one per component.

role.title: Role
role.description: The collision mesh of its component.

light.title: Light
light.description: An empty node with a KHR_lights_punctual point light, a direct child of a component. The KHR light gives its colour, intensity (candela) and range. The light lights the scene while its component is shown. This object gives its shape. Fields that do not apply to the shape are invalid.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: point, tube (a line along local +X) or panel (a rectangle in local XY).

length.title: Length
length.description: A tube's length in metres, along local +X; required for a tube.

size.title: Size
size.description: A panel's [x, y] size in metres, along local X and Y; required for a panel.

oneSided.title: One-sided
oneSided.description: Emits only toward local -Z, with a cosine falloff. Optional for a tube (default false); a panel is always one-sided.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: A point's sphere radius or a tube's thickness, in metres; default 0.1.

baked.title: Baked
baked.description: True when the light is baked into the model's probes. Games skip the light while those probes light the scene. The authoring tool sets it on lights inside the model's light grid.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: The variants the light shines with: names of the file's KHR_materials_variants variants, and null for the model's own materials. Without it, the light shines with every variant.

engineGlow.title: Engine glow
engineGlow.description: An empty node where the game draws an engine glow: local +X right, +Y up, +Z look; X and Y scale are its full size, Z its signed depth.

role.title: Role
role.description: An engine glow of its component.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the glow is drawn; a disabled glow keeps its ordinal.
